card.name: Inside newer brand and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through newly coined brand or generic drug names split into pieces, such as EPKINLY, IMFINZI, RYBELSUS, efgartigimod. It fires on a middle or final piece before the name is complete.

modes.label: Brand names in caps
modes.description: Middle or final piece of an uppercase brand name in label text.
modes.example: 5.1 Cytokine Release Syndrome EPKIN<<LY>> can cause CRS, including serious or fatal

modes.label: Generic names
modes.description: Middle piece of a lowercase generic name such as efgartigimod or paltusotine.
modes.example: VYVGART HYTRULO or intravenous efg<<art>>igimod alfa-fcab product

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unfamiliar, recently approved drug names that are broken into several pieces.
